parse_bolt_config: parse a Bolt configuration dictionary to create a BoltRunner and list of BoltJob instances
create_bolt_runner: create a BoltRunner with publisher and partner BoltPCSClient instances from YAML config files
create_job_list: create a list of BoltJob instances from a job configuration dictionary with publisher and partner args
review_parse_bolt_config: review the parse_bolt_config function to understand how runner and job configs are parsed
refactor_create_job_list: refactor the create_job_list function to support additional job configuration options
